description: On a runner with Docker: a host whose containers match its reviewed list is healthy; a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row is counted in the status, named by container name and short id in the diagnostic, alerts only when usrUnlistedAction is Alert, and the label never reaches the output; when docker ps fails but docker info answers (a shim on PATH) the check says it could not run and alerts. A prune installed by an older Host Maintenance is stale and named in the status, before the no-list exit and with or without a list: a script with no version line, a version below the minimum (leading zeros read as decimal), a stamp that is not a whole number, and the version 1 service that runs docker directly alert by default, name what was found, say which component to run, and respect Warn and Ignore; a current prune changes nothing. The minimum is 9: a prune stamped 8 is stale. Pending removals (a pending-removal file written by the test): no file is nothing pending; two stopped containers recorded by the prune are in the status with the date from which the prune removes them, and alert under Alert (the diagnostic says to Add one to keep it), stay in the status under Warn and leave it under Ignore; an entry for a running container is not shown; one that matches an ignore pattern is counted and never alerts; lines that are not well formed are counted, alert, and are never shown; a list that is not reviewed shows nothing pending. A host without Docker is Tier 2.

steps.label: One running container on a reviewed list
steps.run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/bin; cp /bin/sleep $d/bin/; for l in $(ldd /bin/sleep | grep -oE '/[^ ]+'); do mkdir -p $d$(dirname $l); cp $l $d$l; done; tar -C $d -c . | docker import - tc-test-sleep:1 >/dev/null; docker run -d --name tc-plain tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; mkdir -p /etc/tc-docker; echo name:tc-plain > /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers; echo 'tc-test review' > /etc/tc-docker/reviewed; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Healthy
Hostile label: a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row
steps.run: set -e; INJ=$'x\nstopped-old\t/zz\t\t\t\tfalse\tfalse\tno\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t'; docker run -d --name innocent --label "com.docker.compose.project=$INJ" tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Warn (default): counted in the status, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Alert: alerts, and the diagnostic names it
Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Ignore: still counted, no alert
Failing Docker: a docker shim that fails docker ps
steps.run: real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker || exit 1; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: Docker answers everything except docker ps' '[ "$1" = ps ] && { echo "Error response from daemon: tc-test simulated failure" >&2; exit 1; }' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; hash -r; docker ps; echo "docker ps exit $?"; docker info --format 'docker info still answers: {{.ServerVersion}}'

steps.label: Failing Docker: the check says it could not run, and alerts
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: Docker did not return its container list

steps.label: Failing Docker: remove the shim
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/docker && docker ps >/dev/null && echo 'docker ps answers again'

steps.label: Docker answers again: back to the status with the unreadable count
Stale prune: the list is reviewed and a current prune (version 9) is installed
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=9' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && cat /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers | tail -n 1 && test -s /etc/tc-docker/reviewed

steps.label: Current prune: no stale text, same status and exit as before
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: a newer prune than the minimum (version 10, written 010 with a leading zero)
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' '# TC_PRUNE_VERSION=3 in a comment is not the stamp' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=010' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: A newer prune is not stale, and a leading zero is not read as octal
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Pending removals: two stopped containers not on the list, tc-pend-a and tc-pend-b; GRACE_HOURS=144 in the prune settings; no pending-removal file
steps.run: set -e; docker create --name tc-pend-a tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 1 >/dev/null; docker create --name tc-pend-b tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 1 >/dev/null; mkdir -p /etc/default /var/lib/tc-docker; chmod 700 /var/lib/tc-docker; printf '%s\n' 'OLDER_THAN_HOURS=168' 'GRACE_HOURS=144' 'PRUNE_IMAGES=dangling' > /etc/default/tc-docker-prune; rm -f /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; test ! -e /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal && echo 'no pending-removal file'

steps.label: Nothing pending (no file): the status is as before
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Pending removals: the prune has recorded tc-pend-a (2026-11-20 12:00 UTC) and tc-pend-b (2026-11-21 12:00 UTC), and tc-plain, which is running again
steps.run:
set -e; printf '%s
' '# Stopped containers that tc-docker-prune will remove. Written by the prune; do not edit.' > /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc-pend-a	tc-pend-a	1795176000
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-pend-a) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc-pend-b	tc-pend-b	1795262400
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-pend-b) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc-plain	tc-plain	1795176000
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-plain) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; grep -vc '^#' /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal

steps.label: Two pending, usrPendingRemovalAction Alert (default): both in the status with the date from which they go, alert, and the diagnostic says how to keep one or let it go; the running one is not shown
outputContains: STATUS=2 stopped containers will be removed by the prune (name:tc-pend-a from 2026-11-26, name:tc-pend-b from 2026-11-27); 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels
PENDING   name:tc-pend-a  - stopped container tc-pend-a, recorded 2026-11-20
To keep it: Docker - Update Expected Containers [Lin], usrAction Add, usrItems name:tc-pend-a
To let it go: do nothing

steps.label: Two pending, usrPendingRemovalAction Warn: in the status, no alert
outputContains: STATUS=2 stopped containers will be removed by the prune (name:tc-pend-a from 2026-11-26, name:tc-pend-b from 2026-11-27); 1 expected

steps.label: Two pending, usrPendingRemovalAction Ignore: not in the status, no alert
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: A bad usrPendingRemovalAction is refused
outputContains: Check could not run: usrPendingRemovalAction must be alert, warn or ignore

steps.label: Pending removals: only tc-pend-b is pending, and an ignore pattern matches it
steps.run: set -e; printf '%s\n' '# Stopped containers that tc-docker-prune will remove. Written by the prune; do not edit.' > /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s\tname:tc-pend-b\ttc-pend-b\t1795262400\n' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-pend-b) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; echo '^name:tc-pend-b' > /etc/tc-docker/ignore; cat /etc/tc-docker/ignore

steps.label: One pending that matches an ignore pattern, Alert: counted in the status, never alerts
outputContains: STATUS=1 stopped container will be removed by the prune (name:tc-pend-b from 2026-11-27 (ignored)); 1 expected

steps.label: Pending removals: a file with one good line and three that are not well formed, one of them carrying text that must not be shown
steps.run:
set -e; rm -f /etc/tc-docker/ignore; printf '%s
' '# Stopped containers that tc-docker-prune will remove. Written by the prune; do not edit.' > /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc-pend-a	tc-pend-a	1795176000
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-pend-a) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s
' 'tc-evil-text name:tc-evil 1795176000' >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc-pend-b	tc-pend-b	soon
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-pend-b) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc evil	tc-pend-b	1795176000
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-pend-b) >> /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; grep -c . /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal

steps.label: Lines not well formed are counted and alert, but are not shown or trusted; the good line is shown
outputContains: STATUS=1 stopped container will be removed by the prune (name:tc-pend-a from 2026-11-26); pending-removal file has 3 unreadable line(s); 1 expected

steps.label: Pending removals: the list is no longer reviewed
steps.run: mv /etc/tc-docker/reviewed /tmp/tc-reviewed && echo moved

steps.label: Not reviewed: the prune removes nothing, so nothing is reported as pending
Pending removals: clean up
steps.run: mv /tmp/tc-reviewed /etc/tc-docker/reviewed; rm -f /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal /etc/default/tc-docker-prune; docker rm tc-pend-a tc-pend-b >/dev/null && echo cleaned

steps.label: Stale prune: the prune script has no version line (a version 2 or 3 to 6 prune), only a comment that mentions it
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' '# TC_PRUNE_VERSION=7 appears here only in a comment' 'REQUIRED_CONTAINERS=""' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: No version line, usrStalePruneAction Alert (default): stale, alert, the diagnostic says what to run
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host has no version (installed before version 7); 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Stale prune: stamped version 3
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=3' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: Stamped below the minimum: stale, names both numbers, alert
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 3, older than 9; 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Stale prune: stamped 06 (a leading zero is not octal, and 6 is below 9)
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=06' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: Stamped 06: version 6, older than 9
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 6, older than 9; 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: stamped 8 (Host Maintenance 8, before the grace period)
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=8' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 2 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: Stamped 8: stale, version 8 older than 9, alert
outputContains: prune on this host is version 8, older than 9

steps.label: Stale prune: a version line that is not a whole number
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=seven' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: A stamp that is not a whole number is stale, and the text is not printed
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host has an unreadable version (not a whole number); 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: version 3 prune, and the list exists but is not reviewed
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=3' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && rm -f /etc/tc-docker/reviewed

steps.label: Stale prune and an unreviewed list: both are in the status, the stale prune first, and it alerts
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 3, older than 9; 1 expected: 1 running

steps.label: Stale prune: review the list again
steps.run: echo 'tc-test review' > /etc/tc-docker/reviewed && test -s /etc/tc-docker/reviewed

steps.label: Stale prune, usrStalePruneAction Warn: named in the status, exit 0, no diagnostic
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 3, older than 9; 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune, usrStalePruneAction Ignore: not named, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: A bad usrStalePruneAction is refused
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrStalePruneAction must be alert, warn or ignore

steps.label: No list yet and no prune installed (a host Host Maintenance has never run on)
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && rm -f /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers /etc/tc-docker/reviewed && test ! -e /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers && test ! -e /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && test ! -e /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && echo 'no list, no prune, no unit'
outputContains: no list, no prune, no unit

steps.label: No prune installed and no list: healthy, as before
outputContains: STATUS=No expected-containers list on this host yet; Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] creates it

steps.label: Version 1 layout: the service runs docker system prune itself; no script, no list
steps.run: mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=tc-test prune' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker system prune --all --force --filter until=168h' > /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && cat /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && test ! -e /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && test ! -e /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers

steps.label: Version 1 layout, no list, usrStalePruneAction Alert (default): stale and alert, before the no-list exit
outputContains: STATUS=prune service on this host does not run /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune (version 1 layout); no expected-containers list on this host yet
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Version 1 layout, usrStalePruneAction Warn: named in the status, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=prune service on this host does not run /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune (version 1 layout); no expected-containers list

steps.label: Version 1 layout, usrStalePruneAction Ignore: not named, the no-list status as before
outputContains: STATUS=No expected-containers list on this host yet; Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] creates it

steps.label: Version 2 layout: a script with no version line, the right unit, and no list
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'REQUIRED_CONTAINERS=""' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=tc-test prune' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune' > /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && cat /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service

steps.label: Version 2 layout, no list: stale (no version), alert
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host has no version (installed before version 7); no expected-containers list on this host yet
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Current layout: version 9 script, the right unit, and no list
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=9' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=tc-test prune' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune' > /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && cat /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service

steps.label: Current prune and unit, no list: healthy, as before
outputContains: STATUS=No expected-containers list on this host yet; Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] creates it

steps.label: Stale prune tests: clean up
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && echo cleaned

steps.label: Host without Docker says so and is healthy
